entries.state_summary: Exact-head pre-candidate gates passed. The planned branch-envelope calibration was stress-tested first against the parent compatibility equation between Hodge persistence, the branch-relative geometric obstruction, and the same semiregularity/Hodge detector.
entries.action_summary: Let delta_1 map first-order branch directions to the geometric obstruction object and sigma be the detector used by the parent route. With B_{T,1}=im(delta_1|T_{s0}T), test whether the simultaneously requested conditions sigma(delta_1(v))=0 for Hodge-preserving v and injectivity of sigma on a nonzero B_{T,1} can coexist.
alternatives_considered: interpret the rigid Movasati witness control as a zero obstruction envelope
continue searching for a proper nonzero kernel-free envelope
check the defining compatibility equation before source-specific classification
entries.decision_rationale: The parent failure already states that Hodge persistence sends the actual branch-relative obstruction into the detector kernel. The cheapest discriminator is therefore algebraic: determine whether branch restriction can make the same detector faithful on a nonzero image at all.
uncertainties: the exact obstruction object and detector vary by witness category; the result is scoped to a fixed linear first-order obstruction map and the same detector whose vanishing is implied by Hodge persistence

next_steps: record the scoped linear no-go result and revise the route representation

entries.state_summary: The first-order proper-nonzero/kernel-free branch of H4d1a is incompatible with the packet's own same-detector compatibility equation.
entries.action_summary: Record the scoped no-go: if sigma(delta_1(v))=0 for every v in the Hodge-branch tangent and B_{T,1}=delta_1(T_{s0}T), then B_{T,1} is contained in ker(sigma). Hence sigma restricted to B_{T,1} is injective only if B_{T,1}=0. A nonzero branch-generated envelope cannot repair the parent detector-kernel gap by restricting the same detector.
entries.decision_rationale: The conclusion is elementary linear algebra once the exact source/target maps are typed; it is a route-pruning result, not a Hodge theorem.
uncertainties: a different independently justified detector, a different obstruction object, or nonlinear higher-order structure is not ruled out
residuals: the valid same-detector first-order route must prove B_{T,1}=0 directly rather than seek detector injectivity on a nonzero B_{T,1}
next_steps: open H4d1b as a first-order branch-obstruction-annihilation child; keep higher Artin order, algebraization and globalization separate

entries.state_summary: H4d1a's intended nonzero restricted-faithfulness mechanism is pruned at first order for the same Hodge/semiregularity detector. The remaining productive question is whether branch geometry forces the branch-relative obstruction map itself to vanish.
entries.action_summary: Open H4d1b: for a fixed algebraic witness and Hodge branch T, construct a source-bound witness deformation map whose first-order obstruction delta_1 satisfies delta_1|T_{s0}T=0 by independently verifiable geometry, without assuming full semiregularity or the desired lift; then freeze a separate higher-Artin-order child before any formal lifting claim.
alternatives_considered: search for a different independent detector not forced to vanish on Hodge-branch obstructions
quotient away the detector kernel after the fact
prove the branch obstruction map itself vanishes
entries.decision_rationale: Quotienting the known kernel would erase the obstruction rather than prove it zero. Direct branch-obstruction annihilation is the smallest non-circular same-detector repair.
uncertainties: special-family tangent equality may not persist to higher Artin orders
formal lifting still does not imply algebraization or global continuation
residuals: find a nontrivial source family where Hodge-branch directions are independently contained in the chosen witness deformation image
next_steps: freeze H4d1b context before proposing any new mathematical criterion
